ZDI-24-009.search_text: published ZDI-24-009 ZDI-CAN-22561 X.Org Server RRChangeOutputProperty Integer Overflow Information Disclosure Vulnerability 2024-01-04 CVE-2023-6478 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2023-6478 5.5 AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N ['X.Org'] ['Server'] This vulnerability allows local attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of X.Org Server. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of ProcRRChangeOutputProperty requests. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in an integer overflow before validating a buffer. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of root. ZDI-24-045.search_text: published ZDI-24-045 ZDI-CAN-21319 D-Link DCS-8300LHV2 ONVIF SetSystemDateAndTime Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2024-01-11 CVE-2023-51625 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2023-51625 8.0 AV:A/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['D-Link'] ['DCS-8300LHV2'] This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of D-Link DCS-8300LHV2 IP cameras. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed. The specific flaw exists within the implementation of the ONVIF API, which listens on TCP port 80. ZDI-24-1034.title: Oracle VirtualBox EHCI USB Controller Out-Of-Bounds Read Information Disclosure Vulnerability
ZDI-24-1034.vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Oracle VirtualBox. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute high-privileged code on the target guest system in order to exploit this vulnerability. ZDI-24-1077.vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of oFono. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the processing of SMS message lists. The specific flaw exists within the AMDRadeonX6000MTLDriver. Crafted data in a KTX image can trigger a read past the end of an allocated buffer. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute arbitrary code in the context of the current process.

Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the REFLASH_DDU_FindFile function. A crafted software update file can trigger execution of a system call composed from a user-supplied string. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the device.

ZDI-24-1192.additional_details: 04/24/24 – ZDI reported the vulnerabilities to the vendor 04/30/24 – ZDI asked for updates 07/29/24 – ZDI asked for updates 08/16/24 – ZDI notified the vendor of the intention to publish the cases as 0-day advisories on 08/30/24 -- Mitigation: Given the nature of the vulnerability, the only salient mitigation strategy is to restrict interaction with the application

ZDI-24-1193.search_text: published ZDI-24-1193 ZDI-CAN-23810 Delta Electronics DIAScreen DPA File Parsing Stack-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2024-09-05 CVE-2024-7502 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2024-7502 7.8 AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Delta Electronics'] ['DIAScreen'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Delta Electronics DIAScreen. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of DPA files. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process. Delta Electronics has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. ZDI-24-1194.search_text: published ZDI-24-1194 ZDI-CAN-24058 Linux Kernel Plan 9 File System Race Condition Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability 2024-09-05 CVE-2024-39463 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2024-39463 7.8 AV:L/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Linux'] ['Kernel'] This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Linux Kernel. ZDI-24-1204.search_text: published ZDI-24-1204 ZDI-CAN-23930 Microsoft SharePoint SPThemes Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2024-09-10 CVE-2024-38018 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2024-38018 8.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Microsoft'] ['SharePoint'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Microsoft SharePoint. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of serialized instances of the SPThemes class. ZDI-24-140.title: Autodesk AutoCAD MODEL File Parsing Heap-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
ZDI-24-140.vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Autodesk AutoCAD. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of MODEL files. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length heap-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process.

ZDI-24-149.search_text: published ZDI-24-149 ZDI-CAN-20953 Autodesk AutoCAD SLDASM File Parsing Heap-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2024-02-12 CVE-2024-23127 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2024-23127 7.8 AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Autodesk'] ['AutoCAD'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Autodesk AutoCAD. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of SLDASM files. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length heap-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process. https://www.autodesk.com/trust/security-advisories/adsk-sa-2024-0002 https://www.autodesk.com/trust/security-advisories/adsk-sa-2024-0004 ['2023-06-29 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2024-02-12 - Coordinated public release of advisory', '2024-07-01 - Advisory Updated'] Mat Powell of Trend Micro Zero Day Initiative https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-24-149/

The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to construct SQL queries. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the service account.

User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of IGS files. The issue results from the lack of validating the existence of an object prior to performing operations on the object. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process.

ZDI-24-1579.title: IrfanView DJVU File Parsing Use-After-Free Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
ZDI-24-1579.vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of IrfanView. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the Hotspot Shield. By creating a junction, an attacker can abuse the application to delete arbitrary files. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of SYSTEM.

ZDI-24-194.search_text: published ZDI-24-194 ZDI-CAN-22890 Linux Kernel ksmbd Mech Token Out-Of-Bounds Read Information Disclosure Vulnerability 2024-02-23 CVE-2024-26594 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2024-26594 9.3 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:N/A:L ['Linux'] ['Kernel'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Linux Kernel. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. However, only systems with ksmbd enabled are vulnerable. The specific flaw exists within the handling of SMB2 Mech Tokens. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in a read past the end of an allocated buffer. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute arbitrary code in the context of the kernel. Linux has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in a read past the end of an allocated buffer. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute arbitrary code in the context of the kernel.

ZDI-24-229.additional_details: Linux has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: https://github.com/torvalds/linux/commit/4b081ce0d830b684fdf967abc3696d1261387254

Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability, but only systems with ksmbd enabled are vulnerable. The specific flaw exists within the processing of session keys. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length heap-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the kernel. Linux has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: https://github.com/torvalds/linux/commit/4b081ce0d830b684fdf967abc3696d1261387254 ['2023-08-24 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2024-03-01 - Coordinated public release of advisory', '2024-07-01 - Advisory Updated'] Pumpkin (@u1f383) https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-24-229/

ZDI-24-420.search_text: published ZDI-24-420 ZDI-CAN-22675 SonicWALL GMS Virtual Appliance ECMPolicy XML External Entity Processing Information Disclosure Vulnerability 2024-05-07 CVE-2024-29010 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2024-29010 7.1 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:L/A:N ['SonicWALL'] ['GMS Virtual Appliance'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of SonicWALL GMS Virtual Appliance. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose information in the context of root. SonicWALL has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. ZDI-24-518.search_text: published ZDI-24-518 ZDI-CAN-23880 Progress Software Telerik Reporting ValidateMetadaUri XML External Entity Processing Information Disclosure Vulnerability 2024-05-29 CVE-2024-4357 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2024-4357 6.5 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N ['Progress Software'] ['Telerik Reporting'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Progress Software Telerik Reporting. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed. The specific flaw exists within the implementation of ValidateMetadaUri method. Due to the improper restriction of XML External Entity (XXE) references, a crafted document specifying a URI causes the XML parser to access the URI and embed the contents back into the XML document for further processing. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose information in the context of SYSTEM. Progress Software has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the implementation of ValidateMetadaUri method. Due to the improper restriction of XML External Entity (XXE) references, a crafted document specifying a URI causes the XML parser to access the URI and embed the contents back into the XML document for further processing. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose information in the context of SYSTEM.

ZDI-24-519.additional_details: Phoenix Contact has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: https://cert.vde.com/en/advisories/VDE-2024-019/

ZDI-24-655.vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Delta Electronics CNCSoft-G2. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of CMT files by the DOPSoft component. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process.

An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process. Autodesk has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. ZDI-24-777.search_text: published ZDI-24-777 ZDI-CAN-21826 Linux Kernel ksmbd Out-Of-Bounds Read Information Disclosure Vulnerability 2024-06-14 4.0 AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:L/I:N/A:N ['Linux'] ['Kernel'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Linux Kernel. Authentication may or may not be required to exploit this vulnerability, depending upon configuration. Furthermore, only systems with ksmbd enabled are vulnerable. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of SMB2 requests. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in a read past the end of an allocated buffer. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute arbitrary code in the context of the kernel. Fixed in Linux 6.5-rc7 https://github.com/torvalds/linux/commit/5aa4fda5aa9c2a5a7bac67b4a12b089ab81fee3c ['2023-08-22 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2024-06-14 - Coordinated public release of advisory', '2024-08-15 - Advisory Updated'] HexRabbit (@h3xr4bb1t) https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-24-777/

The process loads an OpenSSL configuration file from an unsecured location. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of SYSTEM.

ZDI-24-802.additional_details: Poly has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: https://support.hp.com/us-en/document/ish_9869257-9869285-16/hpsbpy03895

ZDI-24-803.title: Parallels Desktop Updater Protection Mechanism Failure Software Downgrade Vulnerability
ZDI-24-803.vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to downgrade Parallels software on affected installations of Parallels Desktop. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target host system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the Updater service. ZDI-24-804.search_text: published ZDI-24-804 ZDI-CAN-20450 Parallels Desktop Toolgate Heap-based Buffer Overflow Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability 2024-06-18 CVE-2024-6154 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2024-6154 8.2 AV:L/AC:L/PR:H/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Parallels'] ['Desktop'] This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Parallels Desktop. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute high-privileged code on the target guest system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the Toolgate component. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length heap-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of the current user on the host system. Vendor states the patch was rolled into a previous version of Parallels Desktop version 18.1.0. The issue results from the lack of proper locking when performing operations on an object. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the kernel.

The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to update a configuration. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the service account.

ZDI-24-857.additional_details: Phoenix Contact has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: https://cert.vde.com/en/advisories/VDE-2024-011/

User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of DPAX files. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in a memory corruption condition. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process.

ZDI-24-942.additional_details: Delta Electronics has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/ics-advisories/icsa-24-191-01

ZDI-24-953.title: (0Day) Comodo Internet Security Pro Directory Traversal Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
ZDI-24-953.vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Comodo Internet Security Pro. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the update mechanism.
